lines.text: Today your sprites will send each other messages, and your games will get proper endings.
A broadcast is a message sent to every sprite.
Any sprite with “when I receive you win” starts its script.
One message can make lots of things happen at once.
The star waits until the score equals 5, then broadcasts you win.
The banner receives the message, shows itself and says You win!
The timer counts seconds. Reset it at the start.
When it passes 30 seconds, broadcast game over, and stop all the scripts.
Every programmer makes bugs. Good programmers find them.
Read your code out loud, check the hat blocks, check the numbers and message names, and test one small part at a time.
Now give your games endings, and become a bug hunter!
